investigation.verdict: benign — same food, slightly more specific. Both names resolve to the same DB row downstream. The LLM-as-judge docked the score because the name didn't match exactly, but no behavioral difference. Accepted as judge strictness rather than a real regression.
investigation.decision: ship; do not revert. food_name_quality threshold left at `no drop` per user; future runs that hit the same single-example flip will surface the same way and require the same one-flip investigation.
